content: Amǝ Ifǝrem munǝo arǝ aburana mala Jefta

Amǝ Ifǝrem tunǝ amǝ'lwa malea abanɓwáná, sǝ à yàlî nkaring. À wari a Zafon ace je andǝ Jefta. À ɗì Jefta ama, <<Palang sǝ a wari a lwa arǝ amǝ'Amon, sǝ a tunǝ sǝm, ace mǝnana ɓǝ̀ sǝm kyan sǝnǝa wun ngga ɗàng? Ado ka, sǝm ndo sǝm nǝ̀ pisǝo wunǝ ɓala mò kat.>>
Pǝlǝa Jefta pa eare ama, <<Mim sǝnǝ aɓwana mem ngga, sǝm kùtí aɓa makgir mǝgule sǝnǝ amǝ'Amon. Ən tunǝ wun ɓǝ̀ wu yiu ace amsǝam a ɓabuia, sǝ wu yiu ɗang.

Sǝ lang ǝn sǝni ama, pà wu nǝ̀ pàkkam gbasha raka, ǝn twal yilǝmem a kún buam, sǝ ǝn yàl nkaring aban ká arǝ amǝ'Amon, sǝ Yahweh túrmuria a ɓabuam. Sǝ mana tsǝa ado, sǝ wu yiu yalung nǝ munǝo arǝàm?>>

Sǝ amǝ Ifǝrem bang ama, <<Wun amǝ Gilǝyat aɓa Ifǝrem ngga, wun nda ka yan? Wun nda ka kǝ aɓwana mana wu ɓangŋa, sǝ wu yiu ace kum-àwá aɓa bù-nzali Ifǝrem andǝ Manasa ka!>> Nda Jefta ramba aburana mala amǝ Gilǝyat, sǝ à soa munǝo arǝ amǝ Ifǝrem. Sǝ aburana mala Gilǝyat gandǝ amǝ Ifǝrem.

Aburana mala Gilǝyat ak ban yálì nkaring mùr mala Nggeasala Jodan arǝ amǝ Ifǝrem. Sǝ lang ɓwa Ifǝrem mana auna, sǝ yi bang ama, <<Wu ɗekiam, ɓǝn yàl a nkaring ngga,>> aburana mala amǝ Gilǝyat nǝ̀ ɗì ama, <<A nda ɓwa Ifǝrem le?>> Sǝ ɓǝ̀ pa eare ama, <<Awo ka,>>

pǝlǝa à nǝ̀ bang ama, <<Ɓǝ̀ nda anggo ka, ida, bang ama, <Shibbolet.> >> Sǝ yì ka nǝ̀ bang ama, <<Sibbolet,>> acemǝnana pà nǝ̀ gandǝ pusǝ cau mǝno ka pepè ɗàng. Pǝlǝa à nǝ̀ gbami, à nǝ̀ wal-luí a mǝno yì ban yálì nkaring mùr Jodan ngga. Anggo, sǝ à wal-lú ka amǝ Ifǝrem, á-lumi-ine-nong-ɓari (42,000), a mǝno yì pwari ka.
Jefta ka duk kasǝla mala amǝ Isǝrayila, mala apǝlǝa tongno-nong-mwashat. Pǝlǝa Jefta, ɓwa Gilǝyat paklú sǝ à tsǝì a ɓembe, a la male aɓa Gilǝyat.
Ibzan, andǝ Elon, andǝ Abdon duk akasǝla mala amǝ Isǝrayila
Anzǝm Jefta ka, Ibzan, ɓwa Betalami, duk kasǝla mala Isǝrayila.

Yi ka, ndanǝ amuna-burana lumi-tàrú, andǝ amuna-mamǝna lumi-tàrú. Yi pǎ amuna-mamǝna male à alki aburana mǝnana à pa a tàu male raka. Sǝ amuna-burana male ka, alkia wia amamǝna mǝnana à pà a tàu male raka. Ibzan duk kasǝla amúr Isǝrayila apǝlǝa tongno-nong-ɓari.
Pǝlǝa Ibzan paklú, sǝ à tsǝì a ɓembe a Betalami.
Anzǝm Ibzan ngga, Elon a tàu mala Zebulu, duk kasǝla amur Isǝrayila apǝlǝa lum.
Pǝlǝa Elon ɓwa tàu Zebulu paklú, sǝ à tsǝì a ɓembe a Aijalon, a bù-nzali Zebulu.
Anzǝmi ka, Abdon muna-ɓwabura mala Hilel, ɓwa Piraton, duk kasǝla a Isǝrayila.
Ndanǝ amuna-burana lumi-ine, andǝ amǝkau-amuna-burana lumi-tàrú, mana à kǝ kok amǝdambǝriso lumi-tongno-nong-ɓari ka. Abdon duk kasǝla a Isǝrayila apǝlǝa tongno-nong-tàrú.
Pǝlǝa Abdon, muna-ɓwabura mala Hilel ɓwa Piraton paklú, sǝ à tsǝì a ɓembe a Piraton, a bù-nzali Ifǝrem, aɓa nzali múr-ankono mala amǝ'Amalek.
